summary: Candidate Data Bank Advanced Filters (12 filters) - All tests passed. Backend: 27/27 tests passed (100%). Frontend: 15/15 filter fields verified working on admin page. Filter panel, filter chips, clear all, pagination all functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/candidate-bank/ endpoint correctly implements all 12 filter parameters
Backend /api/candidate-bank/filter-options endpoint returns locations, companies, sources, notice_periods
Skills filter supports comma-separated values and checks both 'skills' array and 'key_skills' string field
Location filter checks both 'location' and 'current_location' fields
Contact hidden filter correctly uses $or to check for null/empty email OR phone
Admin, Recruiter, and Employer pages all have identical filter implementations
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 2032 candidates in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: 12 advanced filters fully implemented and tested: phone, email, location, company, skills (comma-separated), notice period, experience range (min/max), salary range (min/max), source, has_resume (yes/no), contact_hidden (yes/no for missing email/phone from Naukri), capture date range (after/before). All filter test IDs follow pattern data-testid='filter-{name}'. Filter button: data-testid='toggle-filters-btn'. Apply button: data-testid='apply-filters-btn'. Clear all: data-testid='clear-all-filters'. Total candidates: 2032, applying Mumbai location filter reduces to 219.
